parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The health check interval. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the values of specific response parameters. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

parameters.name: LbaStrategy
parameters.description:
The load balancing policy of the address pool. Valid values:

*   ALL_RR: returns all addresses.
*   RATIO: returns addresses by weight.

parameters.name: MonitorExtendInfo
parameters.description:
The extended information. The required parameters vary based on the health check protocol.

*   HTTP or HTTPS:

    *   port: the port that you want to check

    *   host: the host settings

    *   path: the URL

    *   code: the return code. The health check result is deemed abnormal if the returned value is greater than the specified value. Valid values: 400 and 500.

    *   failureRate: the failure rate

    *   sni: specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI). This parameter is available only when ProtocolType is set to HTTPS. Valid values:

        *   true: enables SNI.
        *   other: disables SNI.

    *   nodeType: the type of the node for monitoring when Type is set to DOMAIN. Valid values:

        *   IPV4
        *   IPV6

*   ping:

    *   failureRate: the failure rate

    *   packetNum: the number of ping packets

    *   packetLossRate: the loss rate of ping packets

    *   nodeType: the type of the node for monitoring when Type is set to DOMAIN. Valid values:

        *   IPV4
        *   IPV6

*   TCP:

    *   port: the port that you want to check

    *   failureRate: the failure rate

    *   nodeType: the type of the node for monitoring when Type is set to DOMAIN. Valid values:

        *   IPV4
        *   IPV6

parameters.name: MonitorStatus
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the health check feature. If you set this parameter to OPEN, the system verifies the health check configurations. If you set this parameter to CLOSE, the system discards the health check configurations. Default value: CLOSE. Valid values:

*   OPEN: enables the health check feature.
*   CLOSE: disables the health check feature.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: The name of the address pool.

parameters.name: ProtocolType
parameters.description:
The health check protocol. Valid values:

*   HTTP
*   HTTPS
*   PING
*   TCP

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the address pool. Valid values:

*   IPV4: IPv4 address
*   IPV6: IPv6 address
*   DOMAIN: domain name

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns add-dns-gtm-address-pool --lang en --instance-id gtm-cn-cs02xyk0000 --name test --type IPV4 --lba-strategy ALL_RR --monitor-status OPEN --protocol-type TCP --interval 60 --evaluation-count 2 --timeout 2000 --monitor-extend-info failureRate_:50,_port_:80 --addr AttributeInfo=lineCodeRectifyType_:_AUTO_,_lineCode_: LbaWeight=1 Mode=SMART Addr=223.5.XX.XX Remark=test --isp-city-node CityCode=503 IspCode=465 --region cn-hangzhou
